# Svatantrya Reader (svread)

> Machine-readable Trika Shaivism library. **Start here (agents):** 94 works catalogued; 40 with verified English you can retrieve now; 8 preview-only (UNREVIEWED); 49 withheld/partial (1 withheld by the reader). 55 have a scholar projection, 8 have formalised chunks, 913 trace bundles (231 COMPLETE / 682 PARTIAL). Layers: T1 literal gloss, L0 morphology, ARGMAP argument, L2 reading, C1 essence, L3 final, L4 song. Also: 10 Learn Sanskrit lessons, a 2051-work bibliography with translation links, live Q&A enquiries, and a scholar workspace.

## Start here (agents) — one call tells you what is readable

- **First call:** MCP `readability_status` (no args) → counts + per-work status; `readability_status {work}` → one work's full audit. Static fallback: https://svatantrya.net/data/readability.json. Do not infer readability from a work merely being listed — catalogue is not text.
- **Then read:** `search_texts` (semantic, gate-filtered; BLOCKED English never returned) or `search_chunks` (every layer, diacritics optional) → `passage_evidence {work, target}` for the full hash-checked stack.
- **Withheld ≠ broken:** when text is blocked, `passage_evidence` states why (published versions, trace verdicts, preview availability). `preview_read` returns the UNREVIEWED machine English WITH its rights caveat — never evidence.

## Views (single-page app; these URLs load the view)

- Reader (browse; 89 works have a reader bundle — Sanskrit + workspace; 40 have verified English): https://svatantrya.net/
- Sanskrit lessons (10, Learn/Decode/Recognise tabs): https://svatantrya.net/?view=sanskrit
- Bibliography index (2051 works + 224 mirror, 0 lost/unverified): https://svatantrya.net/?view=biblio
- Scholar hub (per work, ?work=<id>&view=scholar): drafts, review, signoff, DOI
- Pushing Lab (live enquiries): https://svatantrya.net/pushing.html
- Memory wheels (word/sentence/Trika constructors, machine-derived forms): https://svatantrya.net/wheels.html
- Chat: every page has a chat rail answering from that work's gated passages with citations.

- Sanskrit lessons index + rule boxes: https://svatantrya.net/data/sanskrit/index.json

- Catalogue is not text: a listed work may carry Sanskrit excerpts with English withheld (BLOCKED). 'Readable now' means verified English in data/<work>.json; 'preview' means UNREVIEWED machine prose with gates unchanged. Quote the status line from data/readability.json.

Chunk locators (e.g. chunkA-svatyandya) resolve via scholar__passage_evidence {work: ipvv, target}. Its 49 T1.md prose drafts live in translation-work (not on this site).

- This llms.txt is for agents; Google ignores it (measured, 2026). For citation, use a claim page URL.
- Or ask an MCP client with the openpatala-federation gateway for formal__trace {work, target} (plus formal__bridge, formal__gaps, formal__evidence, formal__table, formal__runs, formal__axioms)

## MCP endpoints (Streamable HTTP; call these directly)

- Public read bundle (no auth, ~51 tools incl. scholar__passage_evidence, openpatala__resolve, formal__trace): https://mcp.svatantrya.net/mcp
- Formal only (no auth, 10 tools): https://formal.svatantrya.net/mcp
- Sanskrit reads (no auth): https://sanskrit.svatantrya.net/mcp · index: https://index.svatantrya.net/mcp · translate: https://translate.svatantrya.net/mcp
- Owner console (bearer, all ~210 tools): https://mcp.sanskrit.help/mcp
- Protocol 2025-06-18 (2024-11-05 fallback). Handshake: POST initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. Writes answer -32001 (OAuth not issued); reads need no key.

## Layers (internal codes -> public names; codes are load-bearing)

T1 draft-translation · L0 literal-gloss · ARGMAP argument-map · L2 reading-translation · C1 essence · C2 register-render · L3 final-translation · L4 song. See trika-x layer-names map.

## How to cite (so answers stay traceable)

- Self-verification (no code, no account): https://svatantrya.net/?view=verify and https://svatantrya.net/VERIFY.md — fetch the trace + pack, sha256sum the bytes, compare. Matching hashes prove identity; they do not prove quality.

- Cite work id + chunk locator (e.g. bhairavastava bh-p02) + immutable_id (pt:pid:...) + projection_sha256 when quoting a projection.
- OURS-* translations are machine-proposed, human review pending — say so. Lost works are scholar-REPORTED (finding-aid basis), not witnessed. Scholar essays are SELF_ATTESTED positions unless independently reviewed — say which.
- Never invent a witness, edition, or DOI. If the record says UNPINNED/BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED, repeat that. For full verification, resolve a formal__trace bundle for the chunk and re-run its hashes.

## Rights

- Sanskrit sources: edition-labelled (mostly GRETIL CC BY-NC-SA); specific edition rights unknown unless stated.
- Our English layers: cite with provenance; style/voice examples need author grant (see Scholar permissions).
